rules.rule: Obtain the user's explicit approval before making any commit, whether it contains docs or code.
Commit docs, decisions, planning, and other non-code changes on the current branch without checking out a new branch.
Commit code changes only on a dedicated branch created for that work.
Always wait for the user's approval before making any commit.
Never delete a branch without an explicit user go.
Put code on its own branch.
Documentation and non-code changes may be committed on the current branch.
Do not read or edit the user's .env file.
Write tests first for backend pipeline logic.
Write tests after the implementation for frontend states.
Do not automatically restart the server after rebuilds unless the user permits it.
Never delete world save files such as server-world.dat, server-players.dat, or similar without explicit user permission.
Do not start or restart the RDForward server process unless the user gives implicit or explicit permission.
For schema changes, run migrations after backing up.
Before ETL, detect Excel headers dynamically by scanning for key labels such as EMAIL and APELLIDO.
For schema changes, back up the database first.
Always verify the build succeeds before committing.
